about.title: ARCHITECTING ROBUST ENTERPRISE PLATFORMS FROM ANALYSIS TO PRODUCTION.
paragraphs: With over 6 years of professional IT experience in analysis, design, development, and audits of enterprise applications, I specialize in engineering systems where the user interface is an intuitive surface over intricate business rules, data pipelines, and regulatory workflows.

My production track record spans mission-critical Tele-Critical Care patient telemetry (Agora WebRTC & Firebase), high-throughput Casino Compliance APIs (Node.js, PostgreSQL & Azure Blob with data masking and FinCEN-aligned CTR/SAR workflows), AES256-encrypted Wealth Management platforms (React & React Native), POS Retail Multi-Tenant ERP with warehouse stock reduction, and multi-vendor Inventory Auditing (Shopify, QuickBooks & Greenbits).

I excel at designing metadata-driven architectures, reusable component libraries with HOCs, offline-first SQLite/PouchDB mobile synchronization engines, and secure tenant-aware JWT/RBAC backend services.

philosophy.description: Build once, reuse across modules with metadata schemas, higher-order components, and strict contract typing.
Design applications that adapt dynamically through configuration and metadata rather than brittle hardcoding.
Translate complex regulatory, operational, and financial requirements into clean, testable, and maintainable workflows.
Treat authentication, authorization, payload encryption, sensitive data masking, and audit logging as foundational concerns.
Complex backend workflows and distributed databases should still feel effortless, instantaneous, and simple to the end user.
